## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Change type

- [ ] Product/content change
- [ ] UI/UX change
- [ ] Engineering/refactor
- [ ] Security/privacy change
- [ ] Deployment/configuration change
- [ ] Documentation-only change

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passed locally
- [ ] `npm run build` passed locally
- [ ] GitHub Actions CI passed
- [ ] Vercel preview or production deployment reviewed, when applicable

## Governance checks

- [ ] No core learner workflow now requires account login unless explicitly approved
- [ ] No sensitive data, token, secret, or private learner data was committed
- [ ] User-facing content changes include source/version/review context where practical
- [ ] Accessibility impact considered: keyboard, focus, contrast, readable layout
- [ ] Rollback path is clear

## Screenshots or evidence

Add screenshots, deployment URL, test output, or notes.

## Risk notes

List any known risk, limitation, or follow-up item.
